closures.note: Structural cancellation 9 * (1/3)^2 = 1 forces proto-hydrogen (stage-1 SCm-UA reactant pair) to have mass = m_p c^2.  This closes the proto-hydrogen mass at 0.14% residual from pure structural primitives (no fit).

closures.name: S262-H-atom
closures.note: Hydrogen atom (stage 2) = proto-H + 1 electron = 938.272 + 0.511 = 938.783 MeV.  Adding the stage-2 reactant pair adds an electron to the stage-1 nucleon.  Binding energy 13.6 eV negligible at MeV precision.
